news.headline: McCaffrey opened the scoring with a one-yard touchdown run in the first quarter and added another one-yard touchdown run
news.detail: McCaffrey opened the scoring with a one-yard touchdown run in the first quarter and added another one-yard touchdown run in the third quarter. The two-touchdown performance brought McCaffrey's career regular-season touchdown total up to 100. Exactly half of those touchdowns have come with the 49ers,
